task.name: Complete_flame_effect_postcheck
task.when: After normal or emergency flame-effect shutdown

step.action: Compare every valve, regulator, and power control with the approved shutdown state.
step.ifThen: IF any state differs, THEN keep the perimeter closed and tell the Flame Lead.

step.action: Wait until every component is cool enough to inspect according to 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
Dampen one 🔥 Disposable_Towels towel with the minimum water needed from 🔧 Fresh_Water_Tank.
Wipe leak-test residue and loose playa dust from cool exterior surfaces.
Put the used towel in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Inspect hoses, fittings, guards, effect heads, and wiring for heat damage or new abrasion.
step.ifThen: IF damage is present, THEN mark the affected part out of service and record it in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Log.

step.action: Record fuel use, shutdown type, and maintenance needs in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Log.

passWhen.criterion: The system matches its approved shutdown state.
No leak-test solution, cleanup water, or loose playa dust remains on the inspected exterior surfaces or playa.
No unrecorded damage or maintenance need remains.
Fuel use and shutdown are recorded.
